title: Sólyom László: The Invisible Constitution
goal: I can say what a judge would have done with *ha … volna, … volna*.
I can say what should have been done with *kellett volna*.
I can read a short original text about Sólyom László and use the words *láthatatlan alkotmány* and *anyajog*.
